_note: Protocol = the paper's R code 1:1 up to the CI batch/lr deviation (see the YAML header): measured 2026-08-26 on the refactor/lean-fit branch. Paper App. C.3.3 / Fig. 17, the misspecified case: the DGP's x2 -> x3 effect is linear (-0.3*x2), and a complex shift fitted to it must reproduce that straight line (the flow learns -f(x2) up to a constant, so +0.3*x2). cs_curve_max_abs_err is measured after anchoring both curves at x2 = 0. mean_x3_flow_do_x1 stays unpinned on purpose: the DGP center plus the abs-err bound covers it.

beta13.why: weakly identified: the coefficient multiplies the mixture x1 (sd 0.254 vs unit-scale siblings) — see the _note and docs/paper-replication.md

mean_x3_dgp_do_x1.why: a deterministic seeded DGP draw, like the other analytic entries; only numpy's last-bit drift moves it

fit_seconds.why: 3x the 2-core CI runner measurement (391 s, 2026-08-31): shared-runner wall clock is noisy, so this is a gross-regression tripwire (a lost no_grad, an accidental O(n^2)), not a benchmark
